instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/complex_pockets.step, /home/user/Desktop/tool_candidates.csv in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Machine five pockets, twelve holes, and the outside contour. No selected tool diameter may exceed the corresponding pocket minimum width. Tool rule: choose no more than five tools from /home/user/Desktop/tool_candidates.csv. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-19.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
